blocks.text: Penicillin aik taqatwar antibiotic (bacteria ko maarne wali dawa) hai jo kai qisam ki bacterial infections ke ilaaj mein use hoti hai, jaise saans ki infections: strep throat (gale ki infection), pneumonia, scarlet fever aur sinusitis. Yeh skin (jild) aur soft tissues (naram tissues) ki infections, jaise cellulitis aur erysipelas, ke ilaaj mein bhi madad deti hai.

Penicillin ke structure (banawat) mein do core (markazi) rings hain: chaar atoms wali (four-membered) beta-lactam ring aur paanch atoms wali (five-membered) thiazolidine ring. Dono rings ke saath kuch side chains (saath jure groups) lagi hoti hain. Beta-lactam ring antibiotic ke asar ke liye sab se zaroori hai, kyunke yahi woh jagah hai jahan beta-lactamases naam ke bacterial enzymes hamla kar ke penicillin ko be-asar kar sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Skeletal structure: chaar atoms wali ring (C, C, N aur C=O wala carbon) N aur agle carbon par paanch atoms wali ring se juri hai jis mein S, do methyl lakeeron wala carbon, aur hashed bond se C(=O)OH wala carbon hai. Oopar baen ring carbon se solid wedge N-H tak, jo R wale C=O group se jura hai; ring ke jor wale carbon se hashed bond H tak. R gulabi, N banafshi, H neela, S hara aur O surkh.
blocks.caption: Figure 32.2: Penicillin ka chemical structure (kitab ki Figure 32.2 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche baen chaar kone wali ring beta-lactam ring hai (C, C, N aur C=O). Yeh bohat tani hui (strained) hai, is liye aasani se khulti hai, aur yahi penicillin ke asar ki wajah hai. Is se juri paanch kone wali ring, jis mein S hai, thiazolidine ring hai. Baen taraf R wala hissa side chain hai; mukhtalif penicillins mein sirf R badalta hai.

Bacteria ka aik enzyme cell wall ko mazboot banata hai. Yeh enzyme ghalti se penicillin molecule ko apna aam substrate (woh cheez jis par enzyme kaam karta hai) samajh kar pakar leta hai; wahan beta-lactam ring khulti hai aur penicillin enzyme se hamesha ke liye jur jaati hai, jis se enzyme bekaar (inactive) ho jata hai. Bacteria barhte rehte hain, magar theek cell wall ke baghair, aur aakhir phat kar mar jaate hain. Insaani cells ki cell wall nahi hoti, is liye penicillin hamare cells ko nuqsan nahi deti.

blocks.alt: Chaar khane oopar se neeche teeron se jure: cell-wall enzyme apne aam building block ki jagah penicillin le leta hai; beta-lactam ring khul kar enzyme se jur jati hai aur enzyme ruk jata hai; bacterium apni cell wall nahi bana pata aur phat jata hai; insani cells ki cell wall nahi hoti, is liye unhein nuqsan nahi.
blocks.caption: Penicillin bacteria par kaise asar karti hai (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar se neeche parhein: enzyme penicillin ko apna building block samajh kar pakarta hai; beta-lactam ring khul kar enzyme se hamesha ke liye jur jaati hai; enzyme ruk jaata hai to bacterium mazboot cell wall nahi bana pata aur phat jaata hai. Aakhri khana yaad dilata hai ke hamare cells ki cell wall hoti hi nahi, is liye un par yeh asar nahi hota.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke penicillin “enzyme ke amino acid sequence jaisi” dikhti hai. Sahi yeh hai ke penicillin enzyme ke substrate (woh cheez jis par enzyme kaam karta hai: cell wall ke building block ka D-Ala-D-Ala wala sira) jaisi dikhti hai, khud enzyme jaisi nahi; isi liye enzyme ise pakar leta hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: 1928 mein Alexander Fleming ne ittefaq se penicillin dhoondi. Unhon ne dekha ke aik contaminated (gandi) petri dish par ugne wali mold (phaphoond) ne apne ird gird ke bacteria maar diye the. Yeh mold, jise baad mein Penicillium pehchana gaya, aik aisi cheez chhorti thi jo bacteria ki growth (barhna) rok deti thi. Is chance observation (ittefaq se dekhi gayi baat) se pehli antibiotic bani aur modern medicine badal gayi.

blocks.prompt: Penicillin insaani cells ko nuqsan kyun nahi deti?
blocks.explanation: Yeh bacteria ki cell wall banane wala enzyme rok kar kaam karti hai, aur insaani cells ki cell wall hoti hi nahi.

items: Penicillin: four-membered beta-lactam ring + five-membered thiazolidine ring.
Beta-lactam ring khul kar cell wall ke enzyme se jur jaati hai; enzyme bekaar, bacteria phat kar marte hain.
Beta-lactamases penicillin ko be-asar kar sakte hain.
Insaani cells mein cell wall nahi, is liye nuqsan nahi.
